If you can grow it in your zone, I'd suggest something like gold dust alyssum planted with it. It's very hardy, mostly evergreen, and will hide the base of the bulbs and deter pests from digging. Remember come summer that you can cut the foliage off when it's not pretty anymore, they need to store energy to come back next year. The alyssum will hide them when they get to the ugly phase.

If the deer do start to cause problems, a few eggs whites whipped to hard peaks and mixed with a gallon of water, then sprayed on everything, will keep the deer away. If you get a lot of rain or have sprinklers, use bobbex, as it has a fixing agent that keeps it from washing off.
